## Top stories

- Following the US midterm elections, Democrats have secured control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives, dealing a historic setback to President Donald Trump’s administration (Al Jazeera). US markets responded positively to the results, with the Nasdaq, Dow, and S&P 500 opening higher as investors digested the shift in legislative power (Al Jazeera).
- Bangladesh’s garment sector reached a significant agreement to implement a new minimum wage structure effective December 1, following recent labor unrest and clashes in Savar (ANI News; Prothom Alo). Despite this, the Home Minister has alleged that political conspiracies are fueling the ongoing violence within the garment industry (The Bangladesh Today).
- Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is set to lay the foundation stone for the Tk 4,068 crore ‘Mongla Port Expansion and Modernization Project’ tomorrow to boost infrastructure and connectivity (BSS; Channel i Online). Meanwhile, the government is also seeking funding from South Korean entities, including KEXIM and KIC, to support the metro rail and other development projects (Prothom Alo).
- Binance has revealed that hackers behind a multi-billion dollar crypto heist spent months planning the attack, utilizing techniques such as compromised internal tools and fake job interviews (Ars Technica; Hacker News). 
- Bangladesh Bank has taken steps to stabilize the financial sector by relaxing rules to allow a Tk 30 billion loan facility for City Group to bolster working capital (Prothom Alo English; The Daily Star). 
- The AI industry faces a challenging regulatory landscape in the US after voters in several regions passed ballot measures that restrict data center expansion, creating new obstacles for infrastructure development (The Verge; Hacker News).

## AI

- Google is facing intense backlash from political figures who accuse the company of acting as an unregulated monopoly for its plans to disable Search in schools that restrict AI usage (TechCrunch).
- OpenAI CEO Sam Altman jokingly rebranded his X account to "Ram Altman" while defending the importance of high-memory PCs, stating that users should have the freedom to equip their computers with as much RAM as they desire (The Verge).
- Uber reported that AI agents fulfilled only four rides during the third quarter of 2026, indicating that AI-driven automation in transportation remains in very early stages (The Verge).
- Dhaka is set to host the ‘Bangladesh AI Business Summit 2026’ on Thursday at the Bangladesh-China Friendship Conference Center to discuss the potential and challenges of artificial intelligence (Prothom Alo).

## Business

- CVS Health has announced plans to split its pharmacy chain from its insurance and benefits businesses, effectively ending the current structure of the $117 billion healthcare conglomerate (The Guardian).
- Kraft Heinz is divesting its North American coffee business to private equity firm One Rock Capital Partners in a deal valued at $650 million (CNBC).
- UK interest rates are expected to rise as service sector activity accelerates, with firms increasing spending on AI to regain momentum (The Guardian).
- US trade deficits remained elevated in September, defying President Trump's tariff-based efforts to reduce the gap between exports and imports (NYT).

## Tech

- AMD is projected to outsell Intel in Q4 for the first time in history, according to market forecasts (Hacker News).
- A new Debian security update has been released to address man-in-the-middle vulnerabilities in the `apt` package manager (Hacker News).
- Global Brand PLC has introduced solar-powered security cameras to the Bangladesh market that function without needing traditional electricity or Wi-Fi connections (Prothom Alo).
- OpenAI has acquired the startup Pierre Computer (Hacker News).

## Bangladesh

- Police have detained journalist Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury and reporter Rajib Ghosh at the DB office, citing the need to avoid an "undesirable situation," though eyewitnesses present at the scene dispute the claim (BBC Bangla).
- Authorities in Satkhira have arrested a content creator accused of demanding money by threatening to leak intimate videos of his ex-wife (Prothom Alo).
- In a separate criminal case, a court has canceled the bail of Poriamoni and issued an arrest warrant in a case filed by Nasir Uddin (Prothom Alo).
- Bangladesh Bank auctioned another $100 million as the interbank dollar rate surpassed Tk 124, with foreign exchange reserves slipping to $36.43 billion (The Daily Star).

## Education & Admission

- Khulna University (KU) has launched the first Jean Monnet Module in Bangladesh, aimed at deepening studies on European integration (BSS).
- The Lieutenant Governor chaired a Higher Education Council meeting in J&K to discuss institutional governance (Brighter Kashmir).

## Scholarships

- Applications are open for the Precursor Ventures AI & Investment Operations Internship 2027; the deadline for interested students is November 29, 2026 (Opportunity Desk).

## What to watch

- Watch for the official commencement of the Mongla Port Expansion project as the Prime Minister inaugurates the foundation stone ceremony tomorrow.
- Monitor the follow-up discussions at the ‘Bangladesh AI Business Summit 2026’ in Dhaka to see how local stakeholders plan to address AI infrastructure and policy challenges.
- Keep an eye on the implementation of the new minimum wage in the garment sector starting December 1 to see if it successfully de-escalates the unrest reported in Savar.
